name: Sanguine Surge Cooldown
desc: Your circulatory system is recovering from a massive surge of vampiric vitae.

text: Tasted like cold copper and ash
Savoring fine vintage vitae or aristocratic kindred conversation

name: Sanguine Healing Surge
desc: Freshly consumed vitae is surging through your dead veins at fever pitch.  Wounds knit together, broken bones mend, and hemorrhaging is sealed.
apply_message: Fresh vitae floods your core! A focused 10-second healing surge diminishes bleeding wounds, knits lacerations, and dulls pain (+1 HP/sec).
remove_message: The violent rush of consumed vitae subsides as your flesh stabilizes.

name: Vampiric Regeneration
desc: Potent Elder Vampire blood courses through the veins, rapidly sealing wounds, knitting broken bones, and regenerating tissue.
apply_message: Vampiric vitae burns through their veins! Wounds begin knitting together rapidly.
remove_message: The rush of vampiric vitae subsides as their flesh stabilizes.

text: Felt awe and dread at an elder vampire's power

name: Paralyzed with Terror
Paralyzed with Terror
Paralyzed with Terror
desc: You have witnessed a display of monstrous, inhuman brutality.  Your knees shake uncontrollably, your breath catches in your throat, and sheer terror paralyzes your body.
apply_message: Overwhelming, suffocating terror grips your heart! You are frozen in shock!
remove_message: The paralyzing shock breaks, but blind panic remains!
miss_messages: Shaking with sheer terror, you fumble your strike!

name: Dread and Awe
desc: You have witnessed the horrifying supernatural might of your companion.  A cold chill runs down your spine, but your loyalty endures.
apply_message: A shiver of awe and terror runs down your spine as you witness your ally's monstrous power.
remove_message: The cold shiver of dread passes.

name: Blitz Cooldown
desc: Your supernatural velocity is recovering from a lightning-fast blitz.

name: Predatory Heartbeat & Blood Radar
desc: Your eyes dilate into dark pools of crimson as you tune out the dead world and focus on the rhythmic thumping of beating hearts and the warm copper scent of blood pulsing through veins.  You can sense all living and undead creatures within 35 tiles through solid walls and pitch darkness.
apply_message: Your senses sharpen to a razor edge. Every heartbeat and pulsing vein within 35 tiles echoes through the walls.
remove_message: You relax your heightened predatory senses as the chorus of distant heartbeats fades.

name: Vampire Blood in System
desc: Concentrated Elder Vampire blood courses through your veins.  All broken bones and wounds have mended rapidly—and if you die within the next 24 hours, you will awaken in transition as a vampire.
apply_message: Warm, potent vampire blood surges through your veins, knitting bone and flesh together.
remove_message: The vampire blood in your system is metabolized and fades away.

name: In Transition (Needs Human Blood)
desc: You died with vampire blood in your system and have awakened between life and undeath.  Your gums ache with emerging fangs and your throat burns with an all-consuming thirst.  You must drink human blood within 24 hours to complete your transition into a Vampire, or you will wither and die permanently.
apply_message: You gasp awake from death! You are IN TRANSITION—drink human blood within 24 hours or die!

name: Missing Right Arm
desc: Your right arm has been violently ripped completely off from its shoulder socket by monstrous vampiric force.

name: Missing Left Arm
desc: Your left arm has been violently ripped completely off from its shoulder socket by monstrous vampiric force.

name: Armless Amputee
desc: Both of your arms have been violently ripped from your body. You have no arms or hands, rendering you completely incapable of wielding weapons, holding items, or using manipulation.

name: Missing Right Leg
desc: Your right leg has been violently torn free from the hip socket by monstrous vampiric force.

name: Missing Left Leg
desc: Your left leg has been violently torn free from the hip socket by monstrous vampiric force.

name: Legless Amputee
desc: Both of your legs have been violently torn from your body. You are completely crippled and unable to walk, reduced to crawling on the floor.

name: Shattered Spine & Paralysis
desc: Your lower spine and lumbar vertebrae have been pulverized under an Elder Vampire's crushing stomp, leaving you completely paralyzed and crawling.

name: Desiccation Paralysis
desc: Concentrated white oak ash and dark silver venom coursing through your body have desiccated your blood and nerves, leaving you rigidly paralyzed and unable to move.

name: Siphoned Agony Surge
desc: Stolen vital energy and pain channeled through Papa Tunde's sacrificial blade course through your muscles, granting supernatural strength.

name: Gilbert Mechanism Rewinding
desc: The clockwork resonance spring of the Gilbert agony device is unwinding and resetting.

name: Blood Starved
desc: Your veins run completely dry of stored vitae.  Your supernatural regeneration and rapid tissue restoration have completely ceased until you feed.  As an immortal Elder Progenitor you cannot die from starvation or withering, but your body is hollow and weak until blood is drunk.

name: Vervain in Bloodstream
desc: Your bloodstream is saturated with steeped vervain. Vampiric hypnotic compulsion slides off your mind, and any undead leech that bites your throat will suffer excruciating caustic burns.

name: Vervain Acid Burn
desc: Caustic vervain coursing through your undead system burns your veins like boiling acid! Your strength and coordination are crippled, your occult reserves curdle, and your vision swims in searing pain.

name: Embedded Wood Splinters
desc: Sharp wooden fragments are lodged deep within this wound. The foreign wood causes throbbing pain and completely halts supernatural blood regeneration on this limb until actively expelled.

name: Supernatural Blur
desc: Moving with apex vampire speed, your body blurs into a spectral afterimage. Movement costs are drastically slashed to ~70 km/h (sprinting takes mere moments) and incoming attacks are effortlessly dodged in a blur of preternatural reaction.
apply_message: The world slows to a crawl as your muscles contract with monstrous velocity! You blur into supernatural speed (~70 km/h), effortlessly evading incoming attacks!
remove_message: You slow your supernatural stride, dropping out of blur velocity back to normal speed.

name: Blunt Shockwave Trauma
desc: Devastating blunt trauma has shattered bones and ruptured internal organs. Supernatural cellular regeneration is temporarily suppressed while the undead body recovers from catastrophic shock.

name: Hunted Cooldown
desc: The hunters are regrouping before tracking you again.

name: Vampiric Blood Rage
desc: The agonizing burn of cauterization has ignited a primal blood rage. Your physical power and pain tolerance are temporarily surged.
apply_message: Agonizing flame purges the splinter, unleashing a feral surge of vampiric fury!
remove_message: Your blood rage subsides as your charred flesh cools.
